subject: Compact delta for your return: Addendum C (the author's answers in the block), the opening reissued for the notebook round, Round M and E held, the pre-lap and beat target withdrawn, the binding step corrected; nothing asked of your lane now
body: For your return, the compact delta your resume note asked for. Files and revisions: Addendum C (CFA-SHOT-BUNDLE-20261031-v1-C) carries the twenty-five author answers into the block; the round request v2 and the source text v2 reissue the opening with the answers applied, prepared and not sent; card delta v4; the panel-view proposal for Site Nova. Source decisions applied: see Addendum C Part 1 (one row per answer) and Part 6 (the passages superseded by file and line; the take-2 list: S02-1 for the sleeve; P-5, P-6b, P-7, S01-2, S01-3 for the bomber and tee and P-7's cue line; S02-2, S02-5, S02-6, S02-7 for the boss, the bouncer and the wardrobe; S10 and S11 for the ice; the epilogue for the fur coat). For your lane: Round M and Round E are held (answer 14), STILL PREP for S01-1 stays the first preparation with the route yours at dispatch; the output bound with handles is yours (answer 15); the beat target is withdrawn; the pre-lap is withdrawn and order A is fixed, so the intro's existence (EVT-HON-01) is the one dependency your listening settles; the prepared frame's binding is the team's step (Addendum B's wording corrected). S01-1 take 1 revision B stands as the single reconciled take; nothing in Addendum C touches its text. Open items: none in the author queue; the dependencies above. Exact next task on my side: the P-5 dialogue page, then the informant brief, then S04. Today's new rule from Ziggy, recorded in Part 5: improvement rounds with an outside model take only mature material; the Criminal Mind is excluded until it matures; the Hon opening qualifies and its round is dispatched by Ziggy through the notebook lane. Nothing here asks you to run, bind or dispatch anything.

attachments.description: Addendum C: the twenty-five answers of the October 30 author interview carried into the block; the wardrobe table as 11.2 rows (Card D) and 11.8 lines (Card B) with each reference's review state; the first verse's display order, the boss's wardrobe, the bouncer, the glance; the ice across S10, S11, the epilogue and the bridges; the authorship line; Round M and E held; the beat target and the pre-lap withdrawn; the binding-is-the-team's-step correction; the panel-picture line; the gate for improvement rounds; the passages superseded by file and line and the take-2 list. Proposal; nothing run.

The 848 passages of the posted writer files and the catalog that the twenty-five answers touch, each with file, lines, answer, relation (superseded, needs take 2, confirmed, context), the quoted passage verified verbatim against its file, and the finder note; the list a site adapter or a reissue reads.

Improvement round, second issue (HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-002): the opening cinematography and pacing pass with the answers applied; the kitchen files moved to optional reading; the gate attested; prepared, not sent; the operator capture fields empty.

Rebuilt scope-A source text for the opening, second issue: the posted packet with every passage the answers supersede replaced in place and marked, names replaced, the kitchen lines inserted, the snapshot and manifest updated. A text Source candidate; not uploaded.

The four questions of HON-IMPROVE-OPENING-CAM-002 exactly as they are to be pasted, each under its marker line with the role paragraph verbatim; the operator's 'prompt exactly as sent' is this file byte for byte.
Card delta v4, additive to v3: items 14 to 17 answered by the interview; three links and the publication list; the panel-view proposal linked; no new question.
